bake-list-day.name: Bake List Day
bake-list-day.description: Build the day's bake plan from their bake-list sheet and formula file.

case-par-vs-count.name: Case Par Vs Count
case-par-vs-count.description: Compare pastry-case and bread-wall par to the count they recorded for the named daypart.

wholesale-day.name: Wholesale Day
wholesale-day.description: Build the pick list from standing filtered to the weekday on their calendar, plus dated extras or standing-changes they filed.

custom-cake-board.name: Custom Cake Board
custom-cake-board.description: List open cake and wedding tickets from the cake-order folder against the production calendar.

holiday-bake-up.name: Holiday Bake Up
holiday-bake-up.description: Pull the holiday tab on their calendar and the matching bake-list rows.

receiving-shorts.name: Receiving Shorts
receiving-shorts.description: Join the receiving CSV to invoice PDFs they dropped: shorts, damage, qty fights, price only as printed.

ingredient-below-par.name: Ingredient Below Par
ingredient-below-par.description: Compare ingredient par-min to counted on-hand or receiving on-hand for flour, butter, dairy, and other lines they named.

stale-and-waste.name: Stale And Waste
stale-and-waste.description: Recap their waste and stale logs for the dates they named, next to case par if they asked why the case overbaked.

allergen-sheet-index.name: Allergen Sheet Index
allergen-sheet-index.description: Index their allergen sheet against formula or bake-list names: missing rows, two-sheet fights, blank sesame or nut cells.
